data.reason_zh: 摘要显示为一次世界模型微调，未形成多轮自生成训练闭环，故不属持续自改进。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames
scope_support.feedback_quote: Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene.
scope_support.object_quote: We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints.
